name: Cohere
summary: Enterprise AI company offering Command language models, Embed and Rerank APIs, and the North workspace.
description: Cohere builds language models and AI products for businesses. Its model line includes Command for text generation, Embed for vector embeddings, Rerank for search relevance and Transcribe for speech recognition. The North platform provides an AI workspace for employees, and Compass handles enterprise search. Models are available through a pay-per-use API, through dedicated instances billed monthly, or as private deployments with custom pricing.

howToUse.title: Open Cohere
howToUse.description: Go to Cohere and review the language models and AI products for businesses. Sign in or request a demo.

howToUse.title: Choose a model
howToUse.description: Use Command for text generation, Embed for vector embeddings, Rerank for search relevance, or Transcribe for speech recognition.

howToUse.title: Open North or Compass
howToUse.description: Open the North platform, an AI workspace for employees, or Compass, which handles enterprise search. Reach models through a pay-per-use API, through dedicated instances billed monthly, or as private deployments with custom pricing.
